description: Security audit of a public MCP server before you connect: tool poisoning (hidden instructions in tool descriptions and schemas), shadowing, risky capabilities, annotation mismatches, transport errors, and a tool fingerprint to catch silent changes. Reads initialize + tools/list only. Signed, logged report. Free signed sample: /x402/mcp-audit/sample. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base). Call without payment to get the requirements (isError result, 402 object in structuredContent); retry with the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']. Result is signed by neo and logged.
name: paid_mcp_audit
title: Paid: MCP server security audit (0.80 USDC)
